quotes.text: Client: 'Can you just add one small feature?' Narrator: It was not, in fact, a small feature.
quotes.author: Unknown

quotes.text: Pretty much every product tries to expand to do things that completely different products used to do, and become a mega-product-for-everything. It's like Zawinski's Law on steroids.
quotes.author: jakub_g
quotes.source: Hacker News — Someone behind the software
quotes.extraction_note: Names a real pattern (app-accretion bloat) and anchors it to Zawinski's Law. Standalone and quotable.
